title: Achievements in Public Health, 1900–1999: Fluoridation of Drinking Water to Prevent Dental Caries
authors: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
lineage: Brief research notes paraphrase inspected passages; not a source copy.

passages.note: CDC describes the 1945 Grand Rapids and comparison-community study of community water fluoridation for dental health. This is one public health trial rather than the invention of all dental prevention or a direct estimate of individual benefit.
